name: Govern the Grounded knowledge graph audit skill
description: Documents the governed audit skill artifact so Grounded knowledge-graph review guidance has one canonical source and one rendered skill output.
decision: The Grounded knowledge graph audit skill is maintained as a human-edited source Markdown file and rendered as a generated_document artifact at skills/audit-grounded-knowledge-graph/SKILL.md. The skill source Markdown is the canonical human-maintained content for the artifact. The rendered skill must use Grounded public terminology, include the full trust-status and edge vocabularies, keep a fixed section order, and remain a generated projection rather than an independent source of truth.
